guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, entropy_req_hold_q is reset to zero; on rising clock edge while rst_ni is high, entropy_req_hold_q takes the value of entropy_req_hold_d.
guarantees.cond: rst_ni low triggers reset; otherwise, on posedge clk_i

uncertain_points.claim: The driving logic for entropy_req_hold_d is not defined in this chunk; an incorrect or stuck value could cause entropy_req_hold_q to stay asserted/deasserted incorrectly, potentially gatekeeping entropy requests downstream.
uncertain_points.risk: If entropy_req_hold_d is always 0 or 1 due to a bug, the entropy hold mechanism may malfunction, starving entropy or ignoring pending requests.
